identity.fantasy: A Dawn-and-Dusk inquisitor who juggles Fire, Holy, Shadow, and Physical attacks before cashing Purity and Wickedness into violent judgments.
identity.one_line: A Dawn-and-Dusk inquisitor who juggles Fire, Holy, Shadow, and Physical attacks before cashing Purity and Wickedness into violent judgments. The defining decision is contextual: Procs and opposing stack states continually change the correct follow-up.

mechanics.core_loop: A duality fighter cycling Dawn and Dusk, Fire, Holy, Shadow, and Physical attacks. It builds Purity and Wickedness stacks, maintains Flames of Sin, and cashes out with Torchlight, Stake, Flourish, and judgment effects. Current player reports call it piano-like because of skill bloat and procs; it also has a strong PvP-shaped control and pursuit kit.

modes.name: Dusk Blade
modes.structural_description: Strike an enemy with both weapons, dealing Weapon Damage plus 10 + 15% shadow SP Shadow damage, piercing resistances. Heals for 25% of damage dealt.

modes.name: Flourish
modes.structural_description: Perform an advanced flourish, dealing 207 + 100% AP Fire damage to nearby enemies, repeating every 4 sec, and causing your Flames of Sin to cleave up to 3 additional enemies for 20 seconds.Grants you Flames of Sin and increases the duration by 10 sec.

mechanics.single_target: Use Brand to close distance, trap the target, drink Pyro Tonic, then Flourish, Fiery Judgment, Torchlight plus Lantern, Dawn Blade, Purifying Embers, and Dusk spam in the captured PvP setup. Maintain Flames of Sin and Dawn/Dusk stacks proactively.
mechanics.aoe: The evidence is PvP-centered and does not establish a dungeon AoE sequence. Structural area tools exist, but projecting the single-target setup into packs would be speculation.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Its pursuit and control kit is PvP-shaped, but using it well adds substantial execution burden.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Dusk Blade, Stake, Heartstopper, Burned Alive, Evil Doers, Beware!.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Hunt, Darkslayer's Lantern, Evil Never Sleeps, Monster Hunting, Torch the Wicked!.
